planSteps.description: Fill the login field with customer@wajbati.local and password field with Password123!
The customer is authenticated and redirected away from login
Navigate to the meals catalog at /meals
Click on the first available meal item to open its details
The meal detail page loads displaying meal info and reviews section
The favourites page renders with My Favourites heading and favourite sections
The orders page loads showing the My Orders heading and either past orders or the empty orders state message
